notes.title: BBB Visual Novel Release delayed ... again. Yup. Again.
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Just updating everyone as X-MiGuPLAY will be delaying this release. Again. 

The script has been done more or less since (scratches chin, sips some coffee) April 2019ish? One of the draw backs of producing games alone is... when delays happen, it can be like a horse kick in the nuts. But I'm not angry. I love making these games and the delays have been driven by positive things like adding content & getting Anya's voice actress to do an F ton of voices to bring this novel to life. 

So what has happened and where are we at?

1. NSFW Adults ONLY is official. The boobs are on the loose. The final decision has been made to keep this visual novel in its original form and not hold back the content that pushes the game into Adults Only land.

2. With the NSFW state locked in, I added bonus content that is appropriately inappropriate. This game will ship with bonus lapdance content similar to Anya's X-Mas Special. Plus we are including some palette modded BBB Power Claw brawling action too.

3. Voice acting. The decision to add voice acting has contributed greatly to the delays. The novel is approx 22,000 words long and we sat down and recorded every word. Voice recordings wrapped last week. Mixes were done this week and currently the sounds bites are being chopped up and exported for game engine import. 

4. Music. I wrote and arranged new music. That too is time consuming.

I think those are all the talking points I got. Hope to release before August and hope people enjoy it when it is done! Hope everyone out there is staying healthy and safe during these crazy times. Cheers.

-M

notes.title: X-MiGuPLAY NEWS & Site update!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam land!

NEWS!

[b]1. X-MiGuPLAY  has updated xmiguplay.com[/b] for 2020. Upcoming games have been added to the site and we tried to pull the site out of the 90s and give it a more modern feel! As always opinions are welcomed!

[b]2. X-MiGuPLAY's Business standing[/b]: How to deliver this without it coming across the [i]wrong way?[/i]

Let me try. So ... we are profitable! Now, we haven't  sold a million copies or anything crazy but, I wanted to announce this. I was doing some marketing research and learned that most indie devs fail in regard to recovering initial investments. 

I am happy to say we have covered our initial investment and while we maintain a small  revolving debt for investments, as any company would, we were stoked to see that we hit this milestone.   

From the outside looking in, it may seem that our traffic is pretty dismal but, as we discovered in our traffic breakdowns, we learned that we've actually ranked on Best Sellers on several occasions. So, long story short, [b]THANK YOU to all that have supported this venture ... 

This truly is a labor of love and we are committed to bringing more content and improving along the way![/b]

[b]3. Bare Boob Brawlerz's's'ss Visual Novel[/b] will come out ... but when it is ready! The delays on this title have been driven by adding more & more illustrative work, which is pretty time consuming. Almost all frames involve scene pre-renders with 3D models and then digitally drawn Manga inspired adaptations. In addition to that, we are scheduling time for voicing the entire thing. Novel is currently pushing 22,000 words and we've surpassed 200 illustrations thus far.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/906560/Bare_Boob_Brawlerz_Novel_01_Visual_Novel/

[b]4. Dr. DONG is coming [/b]: its in pre-production now, core plot scripting, character designs and environmental plotting is pretty much what we are working on now. I hope the game comes out this year but, that could be pretty unrealistic sooooo ... we shall see. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217950/Dr_Dick_Dong_Stripper_Underworld/


That's all I got to blab about. So, thank you and have a dope a$$ weekend!

Regards, 
-M

notes.title: X-MiGu Fighter version 1.3 is live!!
notes.notes:
X-MiGu FIGHTERS (XMF) version 1.3 update live!

What's new?

-LOWER SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS: Users now have the option of running the game with Graphics set to HIGH or LOW. This allows most users that don't have an NVIDIA grade graphics card to still enjoy the game. If you are using INTEL HD integrated graphics or equivalent, most modern computers should run the game smoothly. Users that are close to minimum computer specifications may notice improved game play if all other applications are closed and that Windows is not running any background processes. Store front has screen shots of LOW vs HIGH graphics mode.

-MEMORY MANAGEMENT: XMF has new code managing RAM usage. Sprite sheets were rearranged in conjunction with this code to help the game run more efficiently. Users playing XMF before 11.18.2018 will notice the addition of 'loading screens' to help users be aware of when texture data is being preloaded or flushed from system memory.

-SOKO GLITCH PATCH: XMFv1.2 had an index error where when fighting against the AI, the image indexing script would draw the wrong character sprite (SOKONAI blocking) - this has been resolved.

-HEALTH TOO LONG: This change was straight user feedback, initial health value has been reduce to prevent the matches from "dragging on". :)



Thank you everyone that provided X-MiGuPLAY feedback.
Stripper Anya Demon Slayer is up next for a massive update. Check out the store page and wish list the game if you have not purchased it already.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/671630/STRIPPER_ANYA_DEMON_SLAYER/

Coming next is year is our new title BARE BOOB BRAWLERZ: POWER CLAW ... As per customer feedback, this game will feature only female combatants, no aliens or dongs ... we'll maybe one. Alien. No dongs. As promised. Maybe. lol
https://store.steampowered.com/app/892160/BARE_BOOB_BRAWLERZ_POWER_CLAW/



Regards, 
-M

notes.title: X-MiGuFighters is getting a PATCH!
notes.notes:
Hello all. 

Today X-MiGu is announcing a patch for X-MiGuFighters that is coming soon.

Why and what to expect?

As I've broken ground on developing Bare BooB Brawlers: Power Claw https://store.steampowered.com/app/892160/BARE_BOOB_BRAWLERZ_POWER_CLAW/
... the first thing I did was look back to X-MiGuFighters and analyze what I wish the game had done better. Some aspects that I would like to improve are so deep rooted into the foundational code that I am hella-scuurd to borke this game. For example, lack of variable air combat and a combo system that could be better.

More importantly, a lot of customer feedback has been analyzed and some interesting issues have been uncovered. In preparation of ensuring Bare Boob Brawlers can be as good as possible for the TNA-DGAF-2D-Fighter community, we will be implementing a patch that should improve this game for everyone and help all our future titles improve.

1. SCREEN RESOLUTION issues and PERFORMANCE issues: When the game launches, it currently launches in Borderless Window mode and at 1920x1080. Most systems auto adjust the screen but for some users, this was not the case. The end result required users to press 'ALT+ENTER' to switch to full screen fixing the porting issues. IN THE PATCH, the game will launch in FULL SCREEN and convert the native resolution automatically to port to the screens resolution. In our testing, we learned that the game ran significantly smother on the affected systems. 

2. 4K ANOMOLY: Users running 4K systems were experiencing "BROKEN GAME PLAY" ... it turns out if you are running a 4K resolution, the game runs really badly on most systems. So, SOME users should see this go away in the new patch, however, some users will have to temporarily configure their screen to 1920x1080 for the game to run properly despite the patch.

3. MEMORY MANAGEMENT: Our ambition is to deliver larger games with smoother 2D animation and more levels and characters. In preparation for our ambitions and intent for BBB:POWERCLAW to have much smother animation-which means more sprites to yield more frames per second ... we have to change our game's MEMORY management code. This patch will introduce a new script for off loading unneeded data that was bogging down VRAM and cause the game's INI time to lag. Though with the patch, you may experience slight lag in between matches caused by the purging of unneeded sprites and loading of new, we are expecting better over all performance and reduction in minimum required specs.

A new announcement will come when the patch is live and thank you!

-M

notes.title: X-MiGuFighters Patch is live!
notes.notes:
Hello all. 

I have pushed updates today 4.15.18 to X-MiGu Fighters.

Updates include:

1. New AI with new physics on how opponents react to softer attacks and sweeps. These changes were made to eliminate the ease of getting the AI into an attack loop/infinite combo.

2. Full Screen Toggle: Previously available feature, now on title menu, players will see "Press F5" option to toggle full screen. This is helpful for users that are not running a 1080p output.

3. Customization for ATTACKS and BLOCKING on Game-Pads.

4. Pause and match quit. You can now pause and quit the match.


Please keep the feedback coming in and thanks for your support.


-M
